metadata.title: Perler Beads Pattern Generator
metadata.description: Upload images, adjust precision, and generate pixel art patterns with one click

hero.title: Create Perler Bead Patterns with Ease
hero.subtitle: Upload any image and transform it into a smart pixel art pattern
hero.description: Upload, adjust, and download. A simple yet powerful tool for generating perler bead patterns.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to create perfect bead patterns

pixelization.title: Smart Pixelization
pixelization.description: Intelligent pixelization based on dominant colors for clean patterns. Freely adjust the granularity.

palette.title: Multi-brand Color Palettes
palette.description: Supports MARD, COCO, Manman, Panpan, Mixiaowo and other brand color systems.

merging.title: Auto Color Merging
merging.description: BFS-based automatic merging of similar colors to eliminate noise and create clean color regions.

background.title: Background Removal
background.description: Automatically detects and removes external backgrounds using boundary flood fill algorithm.

editing.title: Manual Editing
editing.description: Fine-tune details manually with color picker, paint, and eraser tools.

export.title: Export Patterns & Lists
export.description: Download patterns with color keys and purchase lists with per-color bead counts as PNG.

step1.title: Upload Image
step1.description: Drag and drop or click to upload a JPG or PNG image.

step2.title: Adjust Settings
step2.description: Choose granularity, color merge strength, and color palette to customize your pattern.

step3.title: Download
step3.description: Download your finished pattern and purchase list to start making perler beads.

colorSystems.title: Supported Color Systems
colorSystems.subtitle: Compatible with major bead brand color systems

footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js and Canvas API
